name: Dinosaur Evolution Simulator
desc:
🙌🏼 Welcome to the Dinosaur Evolution Simulator ! 🙌🏼

Dinosaur Ride Simulator is a game suitable for all age groups and dinosaurs. Whether you want to ride T-rex, Triceratops, or Pteranodon, you can find your favorite dinosaurs here. So what are you waiting for? Jump onto your dinosaur and start your adventure! 

💥 Destroy buildings to upgrade and unlock new dinosaurs! 
💪🏻 Become a giant dinosaur! 
🚀 Evolved to grow faster! 
👍 Give us a like to unlock a new dinosaur.
🏰 The new map will be open soon. 
👍 More free dinosaurs have been added. 

🔥🔥🔥 Final update 🔥🔥🔥:
New Activity!!: Get free bones and frosted dinosaurs, new badges and leaderboards! The first code is [Lucky]!
